name: The Matron Protectorate
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Travel to Kalimdor, friend. Our flight makes its home in the frigid landscape of Winterspring. Once you reach Winterspring, find the caves of Mazthoril.

Upon the icy floors of Mazthoril you will find cobalt runes. Hold one of my scales and stand upon a rune and you shall be transported to Haleh, our matron protectorate.

Give her the scale so that she may scry what it is I have seen and felt, here in this doomed place.
narrative.objectives: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
narrative.offerRewardText: The Aspects insist that we stay out of the affairs of mortals. In this world, however, such a thing is not always possible - especially when one of our own contemptuously disregards such edicts.
narrative.requestItemsText: It is good to see you, adventurer.
